seen.body:
Contract: docs/specs/ledger.md, Authority and topology.
Two effective claims or conflicting terminal states found in a merged ledger appear in qew status and resolve via accept/reject.
Scenarios (each a named walk whose docstring states the failure it prevents):
- golden: hand-merged double claim shows one divergence
- refusal: status never resolves it by timestamp
seen.title: Contradictions surface as divergences
